notes.en: Public preview 0.2.1. A polish release for the five screens: clearer hierarchy, cards, typography and navigation, with brief, purposeful motion for navigation, selection and state changes that steps aside when the system's animations are turned off. No new capabilities. Everything still runs while the app is open, so there is no background transfer and no resident session. Direct APK only, not on Google Play, and it contains no Play Services and no Play Billing.
notes.zh: 公开预览版 0.2.1。这是一次界面打磨：五个页面的层级、卡片、字体与导航更清晰，并为页面切换、选择与状态变化加入了简短而克制的动效；系统关闭动画时动效会自动让位。没有新增能力。所有功能仍然只在应用打开时运行，没有后台传输，也没有常驻会话。仅以 APK 直接分发，不在 Google Play 上架，不含 Play 服务与 Play 结算。
